class IdentityA {p=1;}
class IdentityDerived extends IdentityA {q=2;}
class IdentityOther {r=3;}
function genericInstanceIdentity<T>(value:T){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:T=value;console.log(value.p);return same;}}
function objectInstanceIdentity<T extends object>(value:T){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:T=value;return same;}}
function constrainedInstanceIdentity<T extends IdentityA>(value:T){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:T=value;return same;}}
console.log(genericInstanceIdentity(new IdentityA()), objectInstanceIdentity(new IdentityDerived()), constrainedInstanceIdentity(new IdentityDerived()));
function concreteIdentity(value:IdentityA|IdentityOther){if(value instanceof IdentityA)return value.p;return value.r;}
console.log(concreteIdentity(new IdentityA()), concreteIdentity(new IdentityOther()));
function intersectionInstanceIdentity<T>(value:T&{q:number}){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:T=value;return same;}}
function indexedInstanceIdentity<T,K extends keyof T>(value:T[K]){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:T[K]=value;return same;}}
type MaybeInstance<T> = T extends object ? T : never;
function conditionalInstanceIdentity<T>(value:MaybeInstance<T>){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:MaybeInstance<T>=value;return same;}}
function mappedInstanceIdentity<T>(value:{[K in keyof T]:T[K]}){if(value instanceof IdentityA){const same:typeof value=value;return same;}}
